about_the_game:
What if someone decided to rewrite the past? In an old Italian building, five centuries of history come to life — and a “ghost” claiming to be Leonardo da Vinci is trying to steal the fame of the great inventor. You’re part of a team of researchers tasked with gathering clues, resources, and proof — all in a fast-paced, story-driven adventure. Every location means a new era, a new mystery. Uncover the true history, save Leonardo’s legacy, and stop the ghost… before it’s too late!

Lost Artifacts is a classic time-management game with worker assignment: on each level you quickly gather resources (food, wood, etc.), build and upgrade structures (farm, sawmill, workers’ house), clear obstacles, and manage to complete the objectives for ‘3 stars’ before the timer runs out, using temporary boosts (speed-up, time stop, construction speed-up).

What awaits you in the game:

– Fast-paced time management and strategic gameplay

– Historical mysteries and unique artifacts

– Dozens of increasingly challenging levels

– Stylish isometric graphics

– A rich story with mystery and detective twists

– A brand-new character — the Ghost of Leonardo da Vinci

– Atmospheric Italian soundtrack

– New language support: Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, and Turkish
